location.zh: 精灵太空站 · 太空站资源区

team.tactical_role: Electric pressure, paralysis, and priority finisher
Bulky water attacker and fire or ground matchup pivot

strategy_notes.zh: 火、电、水三系相互补位。烈焰猩猩寻找强化机会，雷伊用先制技能收尾，巴鲁斯应对火系与地面系。 对方全员 Lv.80、个体值 31、学习力合计 510、实干性格；仅使用本形态在 80 级前学会的四个技能，体力和能力按普通精灵公式计算。可自由使用道具，胜利获得赛尔豆与经验。

source_note: Original remake trainer composition using retained catalog species and naturally learned level-80-or-earlier skills. This is not a recovered historical boss encounter. No HP overrides, stat multipliers, additional rules, or unlimited PP are used.
design_notes: This encounter is loaded separately from acquisition and boss definitions.
